descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B19 · P1 · 已知

保留 / 清理没有按 UAT 3.6 实现：13 小时的重点事项、37 小时的任务 / 交接 / 体征都还在；医生不打开 app 就不清；超过 500 个病人时会漏清

票：TFA-94699 in progress · 算 QA bug：否（票在做） · 在哪发现：本地

注：一个根因让 19 条用例都挂了；保留时长本身怎么定，见待决策 D6

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：OAT-04/S01, OAT-04/S04, OAT-04/S07, OAT-04/S08, OAT-04/S11, OAT-04/S14, OAT-04/S15, OAT-04/S17, OAT-04/S23, OAT-04/S24, OAT-04/S26, OAT-04/S27, TC-10/S21, TC-11/S25, TC-12/S05, TC-13/S15, TC-12/S29, TC-13/S29

思路 / Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S16 「37 h 时：项目类型 × 刷新过没有 × 病历处理过没有 → 保留还是清掉」 At 37 h: item type × refreshed × chart processed → kept or cleared

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 At 37 h with the chart not processed: vitals, labs and imaging not refreshed are cleared, active medication rows not mentioned are cleared, and open tasks are cleared. …（UAT TC-13；UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；TFA-94699 AC 1；TFA-94699 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • T2 'Last refreshed' means a new value was recorded. A day-2 Save Note, a Generate, or a prior-note import (old values, Q11) without a new vital, lab or imaging value does not restart that item's 36 h cl …（TFA-94699 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：决策表（decision-table） — 几个条件的组合列成表，每个组合各验一次，看结果是不是按规则变。

Given Hospital chart stamped at T0, in two variants: chart processed at T0+30 h with no new value, and chart never processed after T0. Extra variants: one panel where only some values were refreshed at T0+30 h, and a chart whose only activity at T0+30 h was a prior-note import

When Age to T0+37 h and query the chart

Then Vital / lab / imaging not refreshed since T0: cleared in both variants, because processing without a new value does not refresh. Vital refreshed with a new value at T0+30 h: kept. Within one panel, Cr refreshed at T0+30 h (1.4) and K not (4.2): Cr 1.4 kept, K 4.2 cleared. BP refreshed and temperature not: BP kept, temperature cleared. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-13 37 h bullet + 3.6 + 3.7 + TFA-94699 AC 1/2 + PR #98's definition of 'processed' (Q8). Backend read per cell. The mixed-panel cells are judged per item, as 3.7 and AC 2 read it ('a new value was recorded'). Main stamps whole panels, so a kept K 4.2 or temperature is a Fail. The import cells are judged under AC 2 (old values are not a refresh); Q11 could change that

在哪跑：本地 manual（时间 lane，脚本代人做）；测试方法 TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（manual）

S16 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-13.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

37 小时时过期数据还在：刷新了 Cr 旧的 K 4.2 也留着、刷新了血压旧体温也留着，导入旧笔记会重置化验和影像的计时，从没处理过的病历上的未完成任务永远不清。

At 37 h stale values survive: refreshing Cr keeps the old K 4.2, and refreshing BP keeps the old temperature. A prior-note import restarts the lab and imaging clocks, and an open task on a never-processed chart is never cleared.

依据：allure a7649758: 17 of 23 cells pass, and the result says Known (TFA-94699 in progress; T2/U10). Already recorded: one clock per panel (TC-13 risks; PR #100 notes per-value expiry is not built), the import restamping labsUpdatedAt/radiologyUpdatedAt (OAT-04 K16, TC-13 Q11), and open tasks never purged (K2). Side observation: the import added 'Creatinine 1.1' next to the existing 'Cr 1.1'.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane manual。

测试方法：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟）；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：manual。

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S16

At 37 h: item type × refreshed × chart processed → kept or cleared

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

本地新 lane manual：manual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（manual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：api spec. Decision table at T0+37 h. Variants built by writing T0 stamps at now − 37 h and the T0+30 h activity at now − 7 h: chart processed at 30 h with no new value (notesProcessedAt only), never processed, Cr refreshed at 30 h with K not (labs panel as main stores it: one labsUpdatedAt), BP refreshed with temperature not, prior-note import only at 30 h (previousNotes row with source explicit-import, extractedAt 30 h; labs/radiology stamps untouched, as the import path writes), active med mentioned at 30 h vs not, held med and open task with/without processing at 30 h. applyLifecycle; read per cell. — Deterministic server cells.

Detail:

17/23 judged cells pass (1 of them not discriminating on main), 2 recorded. Fail: never processed: open task cleared [U10; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | lab panel: K not refreshed since T0 (4.2) cleared [U10; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | vitals: temperature not refreshed since T0 cleared [U10; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | import only at 30 h: T0's lab still cleared at 37 h [T2; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | import only at 30 h: T0's imaging still cleared at 37 h [T2; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress] | import only at 30 h: labsUpdatedAt / radiologyUpdatedAt not moved by the import [T2; gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress]. Recorded: import only at 30 h: held med (Q8) = "cleared" | import only at 30 h: open task (Q8) = "kept".

产品问题：Known (TFA-94699 in progress; T2/U10). Main stamps one clock per panel. When Cr is refreshed at 30 h, the unrefreshed K 4.2 stays at 37 h, and temperature 99.1 stays when only BP was refreshed. A prior-note import of an old note (Oct 11: Cr 1.1, CXR) moves labsUpdatedAt and radiologyUpdatedAt to the import time, so T0's labs and imaging survive 37 h. An open task on a never-processed chart is never cleared. Side observation outside this oracle (TC-13 U4): the same import added 'Creatinine 1.1' as a second lab row next to the existing 'Cr 1.1'.

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Stamping single values, panels and the chart's processing times at T0 and T0+30 h and then aging the chart to T0+37 h needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation, called with the local stack's admin key); dev has no admin key, so this stays on the local stack (when the helper exists).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
